verdict.rationale: Flagsmith explicitly documents that 'Anything you can do in the Flagsmith dashboard, you can also do via the Admin API' (flagsmith-docs-30/40), and this is corroborated by a real probe showing a full create-project/environment/flag/evaluate roundtrip via the API (flagsmith-probe-rt-2). It further exposes this API to AI agents via an official MCP server and CLI (flagsmith-docs-17/18, flagsmith-probe-3/4, flagsmith-probe-rt-1), reinforcing API-UI parity for AI-native use. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/swagger spec was probed and returned 404 (flagsmith-probe-2), so machine-readable API completeness is not independently verifiable beyond the vendor's own claim.
